material.acceptance_criteria: With 1000 concurrent idle connections the process thread count stays at or below a fixed cap, and connections over the cap receive 503 and are logged as one ev= line each.
material.description: rust/crates/server/src/lib.rs run() calls thread::spawn for every accepted TcpStream with no limit. A connection flood creates unbounded threads; the 5 second read and write timeouts bound only each connection's lifetime.
material.resolution: verifier gm-orch-2-4-v1 at e03ee19: MAX_CONNECTIONS=64 (lib.rs:38), admit() lib.rs:137, refuse() 503 lib.rs:145, conn_refused logged; live probe 70 sockets -> 6 x 503 and 6 ev=conn_refused. CI run 39065835817 job 117493582004 success.
material.subject: The accept loop spawns one thread per connection with no bound
material.witness: verifier gm-orch-2-4-v1 at e03ee19: MAX_CONNECTIONS=64 (lib.rs:38), admit() lib.rs:137, refuse() 503 lib.rs:145, conn_refused logged; live probe 70 sockets -> 6 x 503 and 6 ev=conn_refused. CI run 39065835817 job 117493582004 success.
material.witness_plan: A CI job opens 1000 idle sockets against oscraftd, reads the Threads field of /proc/<pid>/status, asserts it is at or below the cap, and asserts the refusal ev= line appears in the log.
